scripts.sync: npm run web:prepare && npm run verify && cap sync android
scripts.sync:public: npm run web:prepare:public && npm run verify && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && node scripts/build-android.js assembleDebug
scripts.apk:public: npm run sync:public && node scripts/build-android.js assembleDebug && npm run verify:apk
scripts.apk:public:release: npm run sync:public && node scripts/build-android.js assembleRelease && python scripts/verify-apk.py --release --report artifacts/apk-verification-release.json
scripts.open: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.check: npm run test:progress && npm run test:assets && npm run test:offline && npm run sync && npm run mobile:test && npm run test:offline-integration && node scripts/build-android.js assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest lintDebug && npm run verify:apk
scripts.check:public: npm run test:progress && npm run test:assets && npm run test:offline && npm run sync:public && npm run mobile:test && npm run test:offline-integration && node scripts/build-android.js assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest lintDebug && npm run verify:apk
